# HYE WON KIM

## Turning data into business strategy and execution.

::: {.intro-grid}

::: {.intro-text}
Welcome to my professional portfolio.

I am a strategy, operations, and analytics professional with 10+ years of experience across technology, market expansion, business operations, and data-driven decision-making. I previously served as Chief of Staff to the CEO at Blind, where I supported growth strategy, KPI reporting, market expansion, investor-facing materials, and cross-functional execution for a professional community with 12M+ verified users.

I am currently pursuing an M.S. in Applied Business Analytics at Boston University, where I am building stronger technical skills in analytics, forecasting, cloud computing, data engineering, machine learning, and data visualization.
